title: The Sky Came Down
firstLine: The sky came down once, and walked with us.

templates.text: [PLACEHOLDER] We could see right through it. The frogs printed its name, {hero}, and still Wisp walked beside it.
[PLACEHOLDER] It turned against us more often than not. {narrator} still will not say its name.
templates.note: [PLACEHOLDER] You turned against half the bids or more. The creatures took it as a sky that did not like them.

templates.text: [PLACEHOLDER] It brought Wisp back over the hill, and we all waited at the gate. {narrator} saw them first.
[PLACEHOLDER] It kept what it was given. {narrator} says the sky had little to spare that year.
templates.note: [PLACEHOLDER] You kept most of what you could have given. The creatures read it as a poor sky.

templates.text: [PLACEHOLDER] In the Hollow they printed its face every dusk. {narrator} says nobody dared sit near it.
[PLACEHOLDER] While it walked, the meadow grew cold. {narrator} sat by the gate alone.
[PLACEHOLDER] It flew with the starlings, says {narrator}, and Tove flew with it.
[PLACEHOLDER] {hero} walked far, says {narrator}, and came home, and sat on the bench a while.
